query:
SELECT d.`projectId`, p.name, d.status, COUNT(*) as cnt 
FROM documents d 
JOIN projects p ON p.id = d.`projectId`
GROUP BY d.`projectId`, p.name, d.status
ORDER BY d.`projectId`, d.status;
